# V78 DEV2 RC1 implementation and acceptance

The accepted Web baseline is DEV1 RC2 at `3c2b71953a9ef5da319deaed6b5412621fb5d0c5` on `v78-development`. The review candidate is in [draft PR #6](https://github.com/alexandrestp337/Tak-Dex/pull/6) and the [private development preview](https://tak-dex-v77-development.freeclout8.chatgpt.site/preview-build.json) identifies the exact GitHub commit. Production stays on V77.2.1-STABLE at `7046e533ec9d01a8ca520068d7b5cfb092d1ccc2`. The branch shell cache is `takdex-v78.0.0-dev2-rc1`. The isolated preview uses a cache name derived from the commit.

| Requirement | Implementation and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| WEB-005 · Evolution planning and artwork | The accepted baseline reproduced two failures in Chromium. An owned Tepig card showed only Tepig in During, and the Pignite stage disappeared in Final. Both explicitly selected planned stages now render in either view. Artwork is reused for a matching actual stage, with a compact actual cue when the owned Pokémon differs. Identical planned stages use one sprite. The active view still determines the moveset. |
| Independent evolution choices | Planning a Final evolution no longer converts a prior target into an explicit During choice. The selection action has its own async guard, independent of recommendation refresh. During may select an earlier compatible stage, retain Final when compatible or advance Final when necessary. Incompatible branch changes require confirmation. Owned-stage ancestry prevents devolution. Same-stage decisions, locks, deadlines and eligible ownership identity are carried forward. |
| Terminal recommendations | Ranked replacements and team-wide improvements use the game catalog’s existing lineage index to consider terminal forms. Earlier forms remain available in manual search, evolution and acquisition. Existing availability and ranking rules still apply. Unit checks cover terminal branches and unreachable ancestors. Browser checks cover Eelektross and Krookodile, with Tynamo, Eelektrik, Sandile and Krokorok absent from recommendations. |
| Acquisition routes | The grouped picker displays natural routes by deadline, starting species and location. Buttons choose the exact method and keep its route ID, levels, conditions, map link and resource calculations. Natural Route 7 and postgame Route 3 group their documented methods separately. Blue link-trade options distinguish direct Zebstrika from Blitzle with evolution at Lv. 27. Local trading requires the first badge, C-Gear and a compatible partner. The actual-progress deadline uses the verified C-Gear event when the save supplies it. |
| Ownership reconciliation | The DEV1 writer and PID assignment stay authoritative. A traded or caught compatible stage can satisfy a selected acquisition, and same-PID evolution, party reorder and restart preserve the original path and both movesets. Existing two-slot ambiguity and duplicate handling remain in the ownership suite. |
| WEB-006 · Movesets | Each view projects only its own planned selections. Final no longer displays an interim move as a second selection. Per-stage duplicate checks use the selected move, so a legacy transition source does not block a different Final slot. Explicit stored relationships and ambiguous legacy metadata survive read and export. Clearing Final leaves During intact. |
| Move filters | The inline editor reuses the shared 44 px funnel and type tiles. Type and category combine with search and legal choices. The filter button stays selected with active criteria while collapsed. Contextual return retains the slot, editor, filters, query and scroll without focusing the search. |
| Teams and stats | The modal uses aligned Cancel, Import and Create buttons. Focus starts on Cancel. Creation and import choose a case-insensitive unique display name in the same DEV1 commit that writes the team and optional plan. Existing names and local link state are preserved. The stat editor uses an accessible 44 px refresh icon and the existing reset action. |
| WEB-007 · Map Back | A single linked Back control moves to the normal map’s heading row. Fullscreen retains its toolbar return and the general Maps entry retains More. Contextual return uses the original section and page position. Planner return also retains open move editor state. |

## Source notes

- Nintendo documents Generation IV migration as a separate postgame feature at the Route 15 Transfer Lab. DEV2’s early route is a same-generation local trade and requires an existing donor. Black/White unlock trading after the Fennel C-Gear sequence. B2W2 unlocks it after Aspertia Gym and Bianca’s C-Gear handoff. The version-specific save flags already supported by Tak-Dex are BW 115 and B2W2 106. [Nintendo Black 2 manual](https://csassets.nintendo.com/noaext/image/private/t_KA_PDF/DS_pokemon_black_2?_a=DATC1RAAZAA0) · [Gen V trade requirements](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trade#Generation_V)
- Both Unova pairs retain their bundled version-specific encounters. Route 3 in the sequels has its own late access and includes a separately recorded Hidden Grotto method. Zebstrika evolves from Blitzle at Lv. 27. The level and encounter records were cross-checked against published game data. [Serebii Zebstrika](https://serebii.net/pokedex-bw/523.shtml) · [B2W2 Zebstrika records](https://www.dittobase.com/black-2-white-2/pokedex/zebstrika)
- Link-trade entries cover verified standard Generation V species and older standard species with applicable existing native or migration evidence in BW/B2W2. A compatible local partner must already have the Pokémon. Existing external classifications and uncertainty still apply in other games. This stage kept unverified event, form and encounter timing out of the verified route list. Bulk acquisition research remains DEV6.

## Verification

- `node --test .github/v77/acquisition.test.cjs .github/v77/round6.test.cjs .github/v78/import.test.cjs` passed all 25 cases covering route gates and source separation, resource demand, ownership ambiguity, terminal branches and portable import validation including Defense Curl.
- `node .github/v78/dev2-browser.cjs http://127.0.0.1:8912` uses normal click, touch-sized layouts and persisted planner state. `--baseline` reproduces WEB-005 at DEV1 RC2. `TAKDEX_EVIDENCE` writes screenshots of artwork, grouped acquisition and the opened move editor. Tested layouts are 360, 412 and 1280 CSS px in dark and light. The desktop run also exercised canceling and accepting an incompatible Eevee branch change. The geometry checks compare actual image bounds, input and funnel dimensions, route fills and page overflow.
- `node .github/v78/dev2-integration.cjs http://127.0.0.1:8912` covers modal focus and equal-height buttons, cross-tab suffix allocation, the builder reset icon and behavior, portable trade acquisition into a fresh team, save reconciliation, and the position and return behavior of contextual Map Back from Pokédex, tutor, TM and HM, including from fullscreen. The existing DEV1 regression runner covers canonical conflicts, invalid-file rollback, write failures, save sequence and grant handling in the Web contract, and Defense Curl export and reimport. The existing ownership and Flame Wheel return tests exercise the shared browser paths.
- The existing cache-upgrade runner updates from the DEV1 RC2 preview shell to DEV2 RC1 on one origin, then boots offline. It preserves the saved team, plan and reference-pack fixture. Syntax and whitespace checks cover edited runtime files. No physical-device or Android-native test has run.

## Private acceptance

- In Black 2, compare During and Final on an owned evolutionary line. Check the two explicit artworks and the active moveset. Try selecting Final first, then Earlier During. Review the route choices for Zebstrika and confirm the distinction between a direct trade and trading Blitzle.
- Open a planned move. Filter by type and category, enter a search, then go to Checker and return. Check the restored editor and focus, and confirm that its other-stage moveset stays unchanged after an edit.
- Create or import a team with a name already in use, and check the suffix and the stat reset icon. Follow an acquisition link to Maps and return through the title-row Back.

The scoped light-theme change applies to the controls touched here. General neutral-control contrast (WEB-003), coverage-source reporting (WEB-004), Quick Battle stat context (WEB-008), optional precache and pack integrity (WEB-009/010), battle probability precision (WEB-011), the map keyboard combobox (WEB-012), and unrelated legacy rendering paths (WEB-013) remain in their audit backlog. The separate release sequence and Android audit continue to govern those changes.

DEV8 should verify the accepted Web artwork, planned-stage and acquisition persistence, Move Checker and Maps return, and editor focus across emulator switching on the Samsung device. It should also exercise native system Back and the linked-save storage contract from [the DEV1 handoff](DEV8-HANDOFF.md). Web Chromium results only establish the shared Web behavior.
